battle.name: 烏拉爾圖–亞述戰爭
battle.theater: 凡湖以南索爾杜茲平原
battle.brief: 公元前714年，烏拉爾圖王魯薩二世大軍進攻亞述，在凡湖以南與辛那赫里布的北征軍相遇，慘敗於「崎嶇之地」之戰，營地被奪，王僅以匹馬逃回。次年亞述再破宗教中心米薩西爾。卡面埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，相隔約二千五百年，不在此役現場。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元前714年新亞述帝國與高原王國烏拉爾圖之間的一場王國對撞。烏拉爾圖以凡湖為中心，王都圖什帕在湖西岸，國王之下是由湖周「比－艾」貴族構成的骨幹，透過王令、按季徵召與「依苦」役屬制度把各地綁在一起。亞述方面指揮權高度集中：薩爾貢二世之子辛那赫里布親率中軍，兵員來自亞述本土各行省，以及被征服民族編成的常備軍——亞述境內的阿拉米亞述、埃米特人等，另配「獅子」與「蝎人」一類近衛精銳。戰爭同時牽動第三方：亞述銘文記載亞美尼亞高原的「康瓜爾」（Kanguar，即比伊恩集團）諸部作為魯薩的盟友出兵；巴比倫尼亞此時由馬爾杜克-扎基爾-舒米執政，與亞述維持同盟；米薩西爾是烏拉爾圖的宗教中心，崇拜哈爾迪，其城破之後，凡湖兩岸與亞美尼亞的山地方向同時震動。
countriesEn: This war was a collision between the Neo-Assyrian empire and the highland kingdom of Urartu in 714 BC. Urartu was centred on Lake Van, with its royal capital of Tushpa on the western shore of the lake, and beneath the king the state rested on a corps of bi-ai aristocracy gathered around the lake, which held the provinces together through royal commands, seasonal conscription and the dependent labour system known as ikur. On the Assyrian side command was unusually concentrated: Sennacherib, son of Sargon II, led the centre of the army himself, and the troops came from the provinces of the Assyrian heartland together with the standing contingents raised from subject peoples, such as the Aramaeans of Assyria and the Emashites, backed by guard elites of the kind known as the lions and the scorpion men. Third parties were drawn in as well. The Assyrian inscriptions record the tribes of the Armenian highlands, the Kanguar or Biain, marching as allies of Rusa. Babylonia, ruled at that moment by Marduk-zakir-shumi, stood in alliance with Assyria; and Musasir, the Urartian religious centre dedicated to the god Haldi, was the object of the campaign, so that when it fell the shock ran along both shores of Lake Van and through the mountains of Armenia.
people: 決定走向的是兩個人。一邊是烏拉爾圖王魯薩二世，薩爾杜里二世之子；前任在與亞述的戰鬥中陣亡、疆土一度被分割之後，他在公元前7世紀末登上王位。上位之後他放棄進攻改為守勢：在亞美尼亞山口修築長城，封死凡湖通往南方的大道，又在凡湖東側興修引水工程，把阿拉帕恰伊河水引入凡湖的運河，後世稱為「塞米拉米斯運河」，歸屬仍有爭議。正因如此，他清楚亞述一旦沿哈爾迪—阿達亞那之路西進，必取凡湖，必須趁亞述西線吃緊時先發制人。另一邊是亞述王辛那赫里布，他當時正忙於推羅、迦勒比亞與埃地方向的戰事，仍抽調大軍北上應戰。亞述銘文留下關鍵插曲：魯薩曾遞上假情報，聲稱自己將率軍來援，辛那赫里布一度改變部署、把王子的部隊留在北線，直到偵知真相才折返北上，趕在烏拉爾圖軍深入之前接戰。參與者方面，烏拉爾圖一側是湖周貴族與地方首領，亞述一側則有王的鎧甲匠烏拉庫與圖爾坦努級的統帥在東、北兩線分兵；最後把這場戰爭完整記錄下來的，是亞述的書吏與雙語銘文的刻寫者。
peopleEn: Two men decided how the war would go. On one side was Rusa II, king of Urartu, son of Sarduri II; after his predecessor fell in battle against Assyria and the territory was divided for a time, he took the throne late in the seventh century BC. Once on the throne he gave up the offensive and turned to defence: he built long walls across the passes of Armenia to close the great road out of Lake Van to the south, and he worked on the water engineering of the eastern lake, diverting the Arpachai into Lake Van by canal, the so-called Canal of Semiramis, though its attribution remains disputed. Precisely for that reason he understood that once Assyria advanced along the road of Haldi and Atadiana it would take Van, and that he had to strike first while Assyria was pinned in the west. On the other side was Sennacherib, king of Assyria, who was then occupied with Tyre, Cilicia and the affairs of Ezu; he still detached a large army to march north. The Assyrian inscriptions preserve the decisive episode: Rusa sent false intelligence claiming that he was coming to the Assyrian king's help, Sennacherib altered his deployment accordingly and left the crown prince's troops in the northern line, and only when he learned the truth did he turn back north, meeting the Urartian army before it could press deeper. Among the participants, the Urartian side was the aristocracy and the local chiefs around the lake, while on the Assyrian side the king's armourer Urakku and commanders of turtanu rank fought on separate eastern and northern lines; and the men who finally set the whole war down in writing were the Assyrian scribes who cut the bilingual inscriptions.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝時期（約公元前3200年）的工藝：木杆前端裝銅或青銅矛頭，形制簡潔，用途是守城與近身刺擊。它距公元前714年約二千五百年，不可能出現在凡湖以南的戰場，戰場上真正交手的兵器是另一套系統。烏拉爾圖方面配備長柄矛（銅或鐵）、雙刃斧、短柄斧、複合弓與箭、投石索、木胎包革的小盾，以及刀劍；更關鍵的是馬與輕型雙輪戰車——烏拉爾圖是近東最早普及馬匹與戰車的政權之一，公元前9世紀已大量使用，車兵以快速迂迴與車上投射見長。亞述方面以角木複合弓為全軍核心，配箭袋與銅或鐵箭鏃；步兵用長矛、短劍與斧；攻城配有攻城塔、撞槌、擋板與挖掘牆基的工兵，騎兵與輕車兵負責追擊與包抄。到公元前8世紀，亞述的裝備已開始使用鐵製箭鏃、刀劍、鋸與鎬，但骨幹仍是銅合金。遠征的另一半是后勤：驢騾牛羊馱載糧秣與攻城器械，軍隊沿途徵用當地穀物與葡萄酒，冬季則避免在高山深雪中行軍。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the craft of the early dynastic period, around 3200 BC: a wooden shaft with a copper or bronze head bound to its front, a plain form built for defending walls and for stabbing at close quarters. It stands some two and a half thousand years away from 714 BC and cannot have been on the field south of Lake Van; the weapons that actually met there belonged to an entirely different system. The Urartians carried long spears of copper or iron, double-edged and single-edged axes, composite bows and arrows, slings, small shields of wood faced with leather, and swords; more important still were the horse and the light two-wheeled chariot, for Urartu was one of the earliest polities in the Near East to make wide use of both, already in the ninth century BC, and its chariot troops were notable for rapid turning movements and shooting from the platform. The Assyrians built the army around the horn-and-wood composite bow, carried quivers and copper or iron arrowheads, and armed their infantry with spears, short swords and axes; for siege work they had siege towers, battering rams, sheds and sappers for undermining the base of walls, while cavalry and light chariot troops pursued and enveloped. By the eighth century BC the Assyrians were already using iron arrowheads, blades, saws and picks, though the backbone of their equipment remained copper alloy. The other half of a distant campaign was logistics: donkeys, mules and cattle carried grain and siege equipment, the army requisitioned local grain and wine along the line of march, and in winter it avoided moving through the deep snow of the high passes.
tactics: 烏拉爾圖主動進攻而且分路：一路自東北方沿阿拉斯河谷（今日亞塞拜然與亞美尼亞一帶）直撲凡湖東岸與米薩西爾方向；一路自南方越過幼發拉底河上游，進入亞述東境，攻擊邊防要塞與代管城邑，利用亞述主力遠在西線的空檔。亞述的應戰是抽調北征：辛那赫里布把亞述本土行省兵員與被征服民族的軍隊合編成軍隊北上，趕在敵軍深入之前於凡湖以南迎戰。交鋒之地亞述人自己稱為「崎嶇之地」，意即起伏的丘陵地帶，地面崎嶇而縱深有限，極不利於車兵展開。戰鬥過程中亞述以弓手投射壓住正面，騎兵與車兵自兩翼迂迴，切斷烏拉爾圖各部的聯繫，迫其擠壓在狹窄地形之內；關鍵一擊是攻入敵營，奪取營中車馬與兵器，潰兵逃入山嶺後又遭火攻。取勝之後亞述並未繼續深入圖什帕，而是轉向米薩西爾方向；次年公元前713年的第九次征伐攻破該城，取其哈爾迪神廟財寶與神像。防守方真正的屏障是沿亞美尼亞山口的長城與連串要塞，加上冬季封山；亞述人向來選在春夏河流可涉、乾草可備的季節用兵，避免雪季深入。
tacticsEn: Urartu attacked on the initiative and in two columns: one came from the north-east along the Aras valley, in what is today Azerbaijan and Armenia, straight at the eastern shore of Lake Van and the direction of Musasir; the other came from the south, crossed the Upper Tigris and entered eastern Assyria to strike the frontier fortresses and the cities it administered, taking advantage of the fact that the Assyrian main army was far away in the west. Assyria answered by drawing a northern expedition together: Sennacherib merged the troops of the Assyrian heartland provinces with the contingents of subject peoples into a single army and marched north, meeting the enemy south of Lake Van before it could press deeper. The Assyrians called the ground where they met the rough country, meaning broken hills where the terrain was uneven and the depth of manoeuvre limited, which suited the Assyrians and told against the chariots. In the fighting the Assyrians put the weight of their archery on the front, sent cavalry and light chariots round the two flanks to cut the Urartian divisions apart and to press them together in narrow ground, and the decisive blow was the seizure of the enemy camp with its horses, chariots and weapons; those who fled into the hills were burned. After the victory Assyria did not continue on to Tushpa but turned toward Musasir, which was stormed in the following year, 713 BC, in the ninth campaign, its temple of Haldi and its treasure carried off. The real shield of the defence was the line of long walls and fortresses across the Armenian passes together with the winter closure of the mountains; the Assyrians customarily chose spring and summer, when rivers could be forded and dry fodder was available, rather than campaigning in the snow.
data: 可以核實的數字有限。亞述第八次征伐的銘文形容魯薩的軍隊「無數」，如蟲群一般，沒有留下可用的總數；現代學者一般把烏拉爾圖的出征兵力放在數萬人這個量級，亞述方面投入的兵員同樣是數萬量級，雙方都沒有留下編制表，亞述人的誇大之辭與烏拉爾圖方面的沉默都不能當作精確數字使用。戰果方面有物質性的記錄：亞述軍奪取了烏拉爾圖大營內的車馬、兵器與營具，並俘獲大量人員與牲畜。時間上，戰役屬公元前714年；亞述的曆年以春節（尼桑）開始，遠征多在春末至初夏發動，卡面標為四月，取的是春季出兵的通說，確切出兵的月份在傳世銘文中沒有明確記載。距離上，亞述首都尼尼微到凡湖以南的戰場，直線約一千五百公里，循兩河上游的軍用道路則遠遠多於此，車兵與運載牲口的行軍速度決定了實際推進的節奏。攻城技術上，亞述在公元前8世紀已能築高達數十米、底部寬數米的高牆，配攻城塔與撞槌；米薩西爾最終是被強攻所破，但所用器械的細節沒有留下記錄。損失方面除銘文自誇外無從核實，可以確定的是烏拉爾圖的入侵企圖就此中止。
dataEn: The figures that can be verified are few. The Assyrian inscription of the eighth campaign describes Rusa's army as without number, like a swarm of insects, and gives no usable total; modern scholarship generally places the Urartian force in the range of several tens of thousands, and the men Sennacherib committed were of the same order, and since neither side left a table of organisation, the Assyrian boasting and the Urartian silence alike cannot be used as exact figures. What is recorded materially is the result: the Assyrians took the horses, the weapons and the equipment out of the Urartian camp, and captured large numbers of men and animals. As to time, the campaign belongs to 714 BC; the Assyrian year began with the spring festival at Nisan, and expeditions were customarily mounted in late spring and early summer, and the card gives April, which follows the general practice of spring departure, the exact month of departure not being clearly recorded in the transmitted inscriptions. As to distance, the direct line from the Assyrian capital of Nineveh to the battlefield south of Lake Van is about fifteen hundred kilometres, and considerably more if the military roads along the upper Euphrates and Tigris are followed, while the pace of the advance was set by the chariot troops and by the draught animals carrying the loads. On siege technique, by the eighth century BC the Assyrians could build walls tens of metres high and several metres thick at the base, with siege towers and battering rams; Musasir was eventually taken by assault, though no record survives of the exact engines used. Casualty figures apart from the inscriptions' own boasting cannot be checked, and what can be certain is that the Urartian attempt at invasion ended there.
cause: 近因是戰略上的時間窗口。薩爾杜里二世陣亡後，亞述一度把烏拉爾圖壓在凡湖與圖什帕一線，兵鋒直抵南方；魯薩二世即位後雖轉守，仍明白只要亞述的西行大道暢通，亞述王就會沿哈爾迪—阿達亞那之路直搗凡湖，亞述此前已把凡湖南岸的同盟城邑逐一併入，烏拉爾圖的腹地實際上已在亞述弓箭射程之內。加上亞述王位更替之後的混亂：巴比倫與埃地方向的戰事把辛那赫里布拖在西線，魯薩判斷此時是唯一能推進的窗口，於是傾國出擊，並拉上亞美尼亞高原的康瓜爾諸部作為盟友，用以彌補兵力與正面作戰能力的不足。魯薩還同時用信件與宣傳在亞述境內製造干擾，試圖以假情報拖住亞述主力。深一層的背景是整個近東的資源競逐：亞述要的是通向安納托利亞與地中海的商路與銅料，烏拉爾圖要的是凡湖的蓄水灌溉與土地；兩者的邊界線正是幼發拉底河上游與凡湖之間那一段山地，誰控制它，誰就控制東方的貨物流向。
causeEn: The proximate cause was a window of strategy. After Sarduri II fell, Assyria held Urartu in a vice against Lake Van and Tushpa with its spearhead pointing south; even after Rusa II took the throne and turned to defence he understood that for as long as the Assyrian road to the west stayed open, the king of Assyria would advance along the road of Haldi and Atadiana and take Van, and Assyria had already swallowed one by one the allied towns on the southern shore of the lake, so that the belly of Urartu already lay within Assyrian bowshot. There was also the confusion that followed the succession on the Assyrian throne: the wars in Babylonia and in Ezu held Sennacherib in the west, and Rusa judged this the only moment in which he could advance. He therefore committed the whole country to the offensive and drew in the Kanguar tribes of the Armenian highlands as allies, to make up for his own shortfalls of numbers and of the ability to fight in the open. At the same time Rusa used letters and propaganda inside Assyria to create confusion, trying to pin the Assyrian main army in place with false intelligence. At a deeper level the background was the struggle over resources across the Near East: Assyria wanted the trade routes and the copper that led to Anatolia and the Mediterranean, Urartu wanted the stored water and the land of Lake Van, and the border between them was precisely that stretch of upland between the Upper Tigris and the lake. Whoever held it held the flow of goods in the east.
impact: 這是近東青銅時代晚期最具決定性的王國對撞之一。對亞述而言，這場勝利把凡湖—亞美尼亞走廊牢牢壓進了勢力範圍：米薩西爾的陷落等於拔掉烏拉爾圖的宗教樞紐，亞述得以在凡湖南岸與阿爾薩契尼的交通線上重建情報與朝貢網絡，並把烏拉爾圖逼成一味防守的鄰國，此後數百年再無力單獨挑戰亞述，直到公元前6世紀被居魯士率波斯—米底聯軍所滅。對烏拉爾圖而言，王權全面轉向守勢與工程：凡湖兩岸與亞美尼亞的要塞體系、堤壩與運河大規模鋪開，國家經濟重心轉向以凡湖蓄水灌溉、葡萄酒與金屬出口為主，著名的「卡拉柯」窖藏酒正是這套灌溉與階級制度的產物，而貴族階層與「依苦」役屬制度在戰時被進一步固化。對後世而言，亞述把自己的戰果系統地寫成雙語的「致神書」，成為今日研究這段歷史的主要文本；耶利米書第四十九章以「搖動的搖軍」形容魯薩的部隊，說明這場戰爭在西亞的記憶裡留下了痕跡，而亞述在北方的擴張就此收束，也讓後來獨立的阿爾薩契尼得以在城邦格局中發展。
impactEn: This was among the most decisive collisions of kingdoms in the late Bronze Age of the Near East. For Assyria the victory drove the Van-Armenia corridor firmly into its sphere: the fall of Musasir struck at the religious hinge of Urartu, allowed the Assyrians to rebuild their network of intelligence and tribute along the road south of the lake and into Ararat, and reduced Urartu to a neighbour that could only defend, so that for centuries it could never again challenge Assyria on its own, until Cyrus destroyed it with a Persian and Median coalition in the sixth century BC. For Urartu the royal power turned wholly to defence and to public works: the system of fortresses, dams and canals around Lake Van and in Armenia was laid out on a great scale, the economic centre of the state shifted to irrigation from the stored water of the lake, to wine and to metal exports, and the famous Karaköy cellar of wine is a product of that system of irrigation and of that social order, while the aristocracy and the dependent ikur labour system were tightened further under the pressure of the war. For later ages the Assyrians wrote their victory up systematically in the bilingual Letter to the God, which is the principal text for the study of this period today; Jeremiah chapter forty-nine describes Rusa's troops as the host that shakes, showing that the war left a mark on the memory of western Asia; and the Assyrian advance in the north was closed off there, leaving the later independent Ararat free to develop within a city-state pattern.
result: 公元前714年的結果非常明確：亞述在凡湖以南的「崎嶇之地」擊潰烏拉爾圖大軍，奪其營地、車馬與兵器，魯薩本人拋棄車輛、僅以匹馬逃回凡湖一側，烏拉爾圖的入侵企圖徹底終止。公元前713年，辛那赫里布的第九次征伐攻破宗教中心米薩西爾，掠走哈爾迪神廟的財寶與神像，把烏拉爾圖的政治與精神象徵各打擊一次。亞述並沒有攻入圖什帕，也沒有把烏拉爾圖改為行省，它選擇了有限度的勝利：摧毀對方的進攻能力、掠取象徵性的財富、擴張朝貢與情報網絡，然後回師整頓。這兩年之後，北方邊界進入相對安寧的狀態，亞述得以把主要精力轉回西方與南方，而烏拉爾圖則在長期的守勢中把國力用在築城、治水與釀酒上，直到公元前6世紀中葉最後一位君主魯薩三世被居魯士的軍隊打敗、王國覆亡。對亞述而言這是一場以小損失換來大戰略收益的戰役；對烏拉爾圖而言，則是帝國命運由進攻轉向守護的分水嶺。
resultEn: The outcome of 714 BC is not in doubt: the Assyrians routed the Urartian army on the rough ground south of Lake Van, took its camp, its horses, its chariots and its weapons, and Rusa himself threw down his chariot and escaped on horseback to the far side of the lake, and the Urartian attempt at invasion ended there. In 713 BC Sennacherib's ninth campaign stormed the religious centre of Musasir, carrying off the treasure of the temple of Haldi and its images, and striking once at the political emblem of Urartu and once at its spiritual one. Assyria neither entered Tushpa nor turned Urartu into a province; it chose a limited victory, breaking the enemy's capacity to attack, taking symbolic wealth, extending the network of tribute and intelligence, and then turning home to refit. After those two years the northern frontier settled into a relative peace, Assyria was able to put its main effort back into the west and the south, and Urartu used the strength of a long defensive era on walls, waterworks and wine, until in the middle of the sixth century BC its last king, Rusa III, was defeated by the army of Cyrus and the kingdom ended. For Assyria this was a war that bought a large strategic return for a small cost; for Urartu it was the watershed at which the fortunes of the state turned from the attack to the guardianship of what it had.
